versions.subject: Fax Service DLL search order hijacking
versions.detection:
selection:
  EventID: 7 #ImageLoaded
  Image|endswith:
    - fxssvc.exe
  ImageLoaded|endswith:
    - ualapi.dll
filter:
  ImageLoaded|startswith:
    - C:\Windows\WinSxS\
condition: selection and not filter
